environment.name: VLSIT_BUILD_JOBS
environment.purpose: Bound parallel generated C++ compilation workers.
environment.override: Fixed to one worker under the reviewed resource budget.

environment.name: VLSIT_MIN_FREE_RAM_BYTES
environment.purpose: Stop a build before available system RAM crosses the reviewed reserve floor.
environment.override: Fixed to the approved 1 GiB available-RAM stop floor.

environment.name: VLSIT_MIN_FREE_DISK_BYTES
environment.purpose: Stop a run before free disk space crosses the reviewed storage floor.
environment.override: Fixed to the approved 2 GiB free-disk stop floor.

environment.name: VLSIT_MAX_RAM_DROP_BYTES
environment.purpose: Stop the run before its available-RAM drop exceeds the memory-limited pilot target.
environment.override: 1040 MiB maximum observed decrease from the run-start available-RAM baseline; just below half the previous 2.04 GiB coverage-build decrease.

environment.name: VLSIT_RAM_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
environment.purpose: Sample system available RAM and free disk during each guarded command.
environment.override: Sample every 100 ms to reduce guard overshoot.

environment.name: VLSIT_RAM_GUARD_MARGIN_BYTES
environment.purpose: Keep an additional margin above the approved hard available-RAM floor.
environment.override: Require at least 128 MiB above the 1 GiB reserve floor.
